articles.title: 245-Million-Year-Old Fossil Reveals Oldest Known Reptile Digestive System
articles.summary: Scientists in China found a nearly complete fossil of a marine reptile with its stomach, liver and intestines preserved. At 245 million years old, it's the oldest reptile digestive system ever discovered.

articles.title: Mysterious 'Cold Blob' in North Atlantic May Signal Major Ocean Current Shutdown
articles.summary: A patch of the North Atlantic has cooled by 1°C while the rest of the oceans warm. Scientists say it's linked to the AMOC current slowing down — a possible tipping point.

articles.title: Astronomers Discover 'Backward' Exoplanet That Orbits Its Star Upside Down
articles.summary: A planet called GJ 3090 b orbits its red dwarf star in the opposite direction — one of the most misaligned orbits ever found. Scientists can't explain how it got that way.
